description: Source code for Spark's ExternalShuffleService, which provides a server for executors to read shuffle files with optional SASL authentication, including class definitions for ExternalShuffleService and its companion object, with methods for starting, stopping, and managing shuffle files.

classes.name: ExternalShuffleService
classes.description: Manages the external shuffle service, including starting/stopping the server, handling shuffle files, and integrating with Spark's metrics and security.

methods.name: findRegisteredExecutorsDBFile
methods.description: Locates the database file for registered executors based on local directories.

methods.name: newShuffleBlockHandler
methods.description: Creates a new ExternalBlockHandler, optionally using a database backend.

methods.name: startIfEnabled
methods.description: Starts the shuffle service if it is enabled in configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the shuffle server with optional authentication.

methods.name: applicationRemoved
methods.description: Cleans up shuffle files for a removed application.

methods.name: executorRemoved
methods.description: Cleans up non-shuffle files for a removed executor.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the shuffle server and cleans up resources.
